remarks: Come and live in Palmer Hill, the luxury gated community on the Greenwich/Stamford border. This 2nd floor midrise home has beautiful views from every room with walls of windows facing flowering trees in a parklike courtyard. Single level living at its best with 3 bedrooms (or 2 bedrooms plus den) plus 2 balcony terraces and a spacious living/dining area with gas fireplace. Modern kitchen with granite counters is adjacent. New floors, carpet, and paint throughout. The primary bedroom has a spacious walk-in closet and luxury ensuite bathroom with Jacuzzi tub/shower.  Elevator access to visitor lobby and underground parking garage with mail and parcel pickup in the building. 2 parking spaces plus large storage cage and bicycle room. Community amenities include recently renovated clubhouse with community/party room, meeting room, well equipped gym and yoga studio, large heated pool and hot tub. Landscaping throughout the community is beyond beautiful. Be in downtown Stamford, Metro North/Amtrack, or Old Greenwich in 5-10 min....a little more to Greenwich point park and beach or downtown Greenwich.
